name: Coro

queries.query: Coro Venezuela official cadastral parcel map catastro GIS API municipal Falcón
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the official Alcaldía del Municipio Miranda portal for Coro and the national Instituto Geográfico de Venezuela Simón Bolívar (IGVSB). The municipal portal links the SIGAT municipal tax platform, but no public cadastral viewer or parcel API was exposed. IGVSB exposes general cartographic services and a map catalog, not a city parcel service.

queries.query: Coro Venezuela mapa catastral parcelas catastro oficial GIS API Alcaldía de Miranda Falcón
queries.result: La búsqueda en español identificó el portal oficial de la Alcaldía del Municipio Miranda y el IGVSB. La Alcaldía publica trámites y enlaza SIGAT, pero las páginas accesibles no muestran visor catastral ni servicio público de parcelas. El IGVSB publica cartografía general y una mapoteca; no se calificó una respuesta anónima de identidad más geometría parcelaria para Coro.

service.name: IGVSB cartographic services / mapoteca; Alcaldía Miranda portal and SIGAT
service.viewerConfiguration: The official municipal portal is a Next.js institutional site with links to municipal services and SIGAT; page inspection found no cadastral viewer or parcel-layer configuration. IGVSB's cartographic page embeds a general Leaflet map with state/capital/water layers. Its mapoteca page configures a POST endpoint at https://igvsb.gob.ve/api_igvsb/public/api/mapas for general map catalog records, not parcel features.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.outcome: Official municipal portal loaded. Current HTML and linked pages exposed institutional content, news, procedures and a link to https://miranda.sigat.net/; no cadastral viewer, parcel layer, or parcel API configuration was found.

Official mapoteca page loaded and disclosed the current POST endpoint https://igvsb.gob.ve/api_igvsb/public/api/mapas for a general map catalog. This is not a parcel feature service.

Server reported that GET is not supported and POST is required. No POST was made because the endpoint is a general map catalog and not a parcel service; no credentials, tokens, or unsafe fields were requested.
